Container.Name: Revolving-Plex-Manager
Container.Overview: Safety-first, playback-aware and seed-aware lifecycle management for a revolving Plex library. Integrations and Active Management default to off.
Container.Requires: /config must be local or cache-backed appdata. Do not place the SQLite database on SMB or NFS. This container does not require media-directory mounts.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Host port for the administrative Web UI.

Config.Name: Application Data
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite database, encryption material, backups, and logs. Prefer a cache-only appdata share.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used when rendering UTC timestamps.

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Set true when the Web UI is served through HTTPS. Direct local HTTP requires false.

Config.Name: Application Secret
Config.Description: Optional persistent session-signing secret. When empty, a secret is generated under /config.
